# Project Instructions

This repository contains a Next.js frontend and a FastAPI backend for the Student Budget and Expense Tracker.

Before backend changes, read `docs/SRS.md`, `docs/API_CONTRACT.md`, and `docs/FRONTEND_CONTEXT.md`.

Preserve existing frontend field names and API paths. Use decimal-safe money handling, ISO dates, YYYY-MM months, JWT Bearer authentication, secure password hashing, and user ownership checks on every protected operation.

Do not implement excluded features such as bank integrations, payments, AI advice, exports, admin dashboards, or notifications.
